# xacml — XACML 3.0 policies

[All groups](README.md)

## xacml evaluate

Evaluate an XACML 3.0 policy or policy set against a request (XML, or the JSON Profile): targets, conditions, variables, the core function library (equality, comparison, arithmetic, string, regexp, rfc822Name, bag, set, higher-order), every standard combining algorithm with extended Indeterminate, and obligations and advice. Returns the decision, status and missing attributes, a trace of every rule and policy, and what deny- and permit-biased PEPs would enforce. Without a request it only checks the policy.

MCP tool: `xacml_evaluate`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--policy` | string | XACML 3.0 Policy or PolicySet (XML). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--request` | string | XACML request: XML &lt;Request&gt;, or JSON Profile {"Request": {...}}. CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
